rubric: Line one carries the claim, a verdict word (true, mostly true, unclear, misleading, false) and a confidence level.
What is known is kept apart from what is concluded; the true and false parts of a mixed claim are separated.
The reason for the confidence is stated (well documented, changes often, after the knowledge date, cannot see the source).
2 or 3 concrete ways to verify (the kind of source), no invented studies, numbers, names or URLs.
Chain messages get their warning signs listed; health, money and safety claims get the one practical consequence.
